Help for grown-ups

Questions about PinkRyno, our games, or this site? A grown-up can write to us, and we'll be glad to help.

Common questions

The free worlds and the $0.99 unlock

Free from the start: Free Play and the Sun, Earth, and Moon worlds.

The $0.99 unlock: All 10 worlds and every explorer. No subscription. One shared 3-use trial lets your child try locked worlds and explorers first.

There is nothing to buy on this website.

Deleting data

To delete game progress, clear this site's data in your browser settings (often under Privacy or Site settings, then Cookies and site data).

Read the privacy policy

Something went wrong

Write to us at the address above and tell us the game, the device and browser, and what happened. Please do not send a child's name, photo, or precise location. A grown-up's first name is enough.

The parental gate

Links that leave this website ask a grown-up to answer a short multiplication question first. That includes email.

The question is a speed bump so a small child does not wander off to another site. It is not an account, and we do not save the answer.

Calm little games for ages 3–6.
